description:
Anxiety Relief Music | Sarangi Instrumental for Deep Calm | 1.5 Hours

For the days when your chest feels tight and your mind won't stop turning — this is your unwind.

90 minutes of soulful Sarangi, the bowed instrument closest to the human voice. Let it carry the tension out of your body.

What you'll hear:
• Slow Sarangi — emotive, expressive, low register
• Soft tanpura drone beneath
• Recorded warm and acoustic, no electronic processing
• No sudden shifts, no buildup — just gentle release

Best for:
• Post-work anxiety wind-down
• Chest tightness and shallow breathing
• Racing thoughts before bed
• Emotional heaviness that won't lift

Breathe out. Let it go.
suno_prompt_note: PARKED — needs separate exploration. CALM rule mandatory. For Sarangi specifically: emphasize bowed-string emotional expressiveness ('soulful, vocal-like, expressive melodic phrases with meend slides'). Sarangi is closest to human voice in Hindustani tradition — leverage that emotional character. Suggested opener structure: 'No vocals. Solo sarangi, Raga Bhairavi, emotional anxiety-release mood. Cold open mid-melody. Slow ~55 BPM, expressive vocal-like phrasing with meend slides. Tanpura drone beneath — only 2 instruments, no tabla, no percussion. Continuous flow, seamless loop. No vocals, no humming.' Bhairavi has retention proof in Surbahar burnout ships (35-39% AVD) — same emotional register works for Sarangi.
